name: tableau_fixed_lod_under_an_aggregate_is_read_at_its_grain
expect_sql:
SELECT g.g0 AS channel,
       AVG(g.x1) AS avg_customer_units
FROM   (
SELECT t.channel AS g0,
       t.customer AS d0,
       MAX(l1.v) AS x1
FROM   retail.fct_sales t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.customer AS k0, SUM(s.units_sold) AS v
    FROM   retail.fct_sales s
    GROUP BY s.customer
  ) l1
    ON l1.k0 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.customer
WHERE  t.department = 'TOYS'
GROUP BY t.channel, t.customer
) g
GROUP BY g.g0
